title: Soberanía’s Top 10 Stories from Mexico in 2025: #10-6
author: Mexico Solidarity
content:
Welcome to Part 1 of our special year-end episode on Soberanía! In this
segment, we delve into the top 10 stories about Mexico from 2025, covering
stories 10 through 6.

Join us as we discuss the opposition's missteps, the ambitious Plan Mexico,
the influence of US actors in Mexico, mass Morena demonstrations, and Claudia
Sheinbaum's impactful first year in office. Don't miss this engaging recap
with our hosts and special guest, Samuel, as we prepare to reveal the top 5
stories in the next episode.

Stay tuned for part 2 next week!
